ExternalDatabaseInfo.CreateViewSql: select distinct `t`.`SEIBAN` AS `製番`,`t`.`KURADASHI_KOTEI` AS `倉出工程`,(case when ((`m`.`TANABAN` is null) or (trim(replace(`m`.`TANABAN`,' ','')) = '')) then '-' else `m`.`TANABAN` end) AS `ロケーション（棚番）` from (`tbuhink` `t` join (select `m1`.`HINBAN` AS `HINBAN`,`m1`.`TANABAN` AS `TANABAN` from (`mhinban` `m1` join (select `mhinban`.`HINBAN` AS `HINBAN`,max(`mhinban`.`KAITEI_SEQ_NBR`) AS `max_seq` from `mhinban` group by `mhinban`.`HINBAN`) `m2` on(((`m1`.`HINBAN` = `m2`.`HINBAN`) and (`m1`.`KAITEI_SEQ_NBR` = `m2`.`max_seq`))))) `m` on((`t`.`HINBAN` = `m`.`HINBAN`))) where ((`t`.`KURADASHI_KOTEI` is not null) and (`t`.`KURADASHI_KOTEI` <> ''))
